provenance.notes: PIN ORDER: Aosong DHT11 Product Manual (the components101-hosted copy), section 5 'Pin Description': 1 VDD, 2 DATA (serial data, single-bus), 3 NC, 4 GND; the drawing shows 1pin to 4pin left to right with 2.54 mm pitch. Pin 3 is NC. SIZE: the same drawing gives 12 x 15.5 mm body, 5.5 mm thick, 8 mm leads. FOOTPRINT: rigid, pin 1 at [0,0], pins at 2.54 mm pitch along one row. KIT: the kit ships the 3-pin DHT11 module (see dht11-module), not the bare 4-pin sensor, per the kit's Component List photo, so this part is 'not in kit'. SUPPLY: Aosong manual says DC 3.3-5.5 V; the OSEPP-translated datasheet (Mouser) says 3-5.5 V with 5 V typical; 3.3 V is used as the minimum (conservative). Neither gives a numeric DATA output high voltage: the OSEPP signal tables call it 'High (VCC)', so the part records the level as VDD (the pulled-up line). PULL-UP: Aosong manual says an external pull-up of about 5.1 kOhm on DATA is needed for the single bus; OSEPP says a 5 kOhm pull-up is recommended for cables shorter than 20 m. The bare sensor has none on board. RESOLUTION CONFLICT: the Aosong manual lists 16 bit for humidity and temperature, the OSEPP datasheet lists 8 bit and 1 %RH / 1 C. Both agree on the frame: 8-bit integer + 8-bit decimal for each value, and the Aosong manual notes the decimal bytes are 0, so 1-unit steps are used. ACCURACY: humidity +-5 %RH at 25 C in the Aosong manual; the OSEPP table says +-4 %RH at 25 C and +-5 %RH over 0-50 C; +-5 is used. Temperature +-2 C in both. RANGE: 20-90 %RH and 0-50 C from the OSEPP table (humidity 30-90 % at 0 C and 20-80 % at 50 C); the Aosong manual copy lists no measuring range. SAMPLING: Aosong manual 'secondary greater than 2 seconds' (and an advice of more than 5 s between reads for accurate data); OSEPP 1 s; 2 s is used. CURRENT: Aosong 0.3 mA measuring, 60 uA standby; OSEPP 0.5-2.5 mA measuring, 0.2-1 mA average, 100-150 uA standby. TIMING: Aosong manual and OSEPP datasheet agree on start low of at least 18 ms, 80 us response low then 80 us high, 50 us low before each bit, 26-28 us high for a 0 and about 70 us high for a 1, 40 bits, 50 us end low; the 20-40 us host release wait is from the OSEPP datasheet only. The OSEPP datasheet suggests 100 nF between VDD and GND.
